NOT the third-generation 2015–2020 Sienna with a big chrome V mustache across its nose. Long sliding-door minivan, smooth high roof and silver rails, silver alloy wheels. Elevated front-left three-quarter view, front points toward LEFT, roof visible. Entire car fully visible centered with a minimum 8% EMPTY margin on EVERY edge; car width 84% of landscape 3:2 canvas. Soft neutral studio light, restrained paint reflections, clean catalog realism with crisp recognizable shape. Genuine transparent alpha background, no background color or floor, only tiny neutral contact shadow directly under tires. No checkerboard baked in, no people, captions, watermark or plate lettering. Suggested compact output 1024px wide. Return ONLY this ONE complete car. Transparency must include empty margins and all space around wheels.
